gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-109.984017 38.166652)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-109.984017 38.166652)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.858204 37.319739)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-121.858204 37.319739)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN p1.elev > p2.elev THEN 'Canyonlands National Park, UT'
    WHEN p2.elev > p1.elev THEN 'Chinese American Historical Museum, San Jose, CA'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS higher_poi,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;

FROM park_elevation p, museum_elevation m;
